description: Predict, Measure, Collapse (fz-k8w) was written because the Output Contract Loop was forgotten. The two pages described one method -- shrink a noisy problem to one question answerable by hand, answer it from first principles, watch the system answer it, fix the first place the two differ, return to the original for the next question -- wrapped in situation-specific process and detail. Replace both with a general strategy, Paper First, and give every .agent/strategies.md entry a 'Use when' trigger, so the triggers rules.md already points at exist.
title: Fold Predict, Measure, Collapse into the Output Contract Loop as Paper First, with use-when triggers
